# Diabetic Retinopathy

## What is diabetic retinopathy?

Diabetic retinopathy is an eye condition that can cause vision loss in people who have diabetes. High blood sugar can damage blood vessels in the retina.

## Am I at risk for diabetic retinopathy?

Anyone with any type of diabetes can get diabetic retinopathy. Keeping blood sugar under control lowers the risk.
